description: This file defines a Router class for intercepting and handling network requests within a Playwright browser context, including request handling, route management, and fetch override logic.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: A class for managing request interception, handling, and route management in Playwright browser contexts.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Router with a Playwright browser context and optional base URL.

methods.name: route
methods.description: Adds a route with specified arguments to the browser context.

methods.name: use
methods.description: Registers request handlers to intercept and process requests.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes all request handlers and unroutes all routes managed by this Router.

methods.name: _updateRequestHandlersRoute
methods.description: Internal method to update route interception based on current handlers.
